title: smol brains
pitch: an island of tiny creatures with real neural-network brains. they evolve, invent fire, build villages and pray to you. they will learn the wrong things.
controls: drag to pan, pinch or wheel to zoom, twist or right-drag to rotate. tools: grab (carry, throw), tickle (reward), tap (scold), talk (teach words), magic (miracles). wasd pan, q/e rotate, 1-5 tools, space pause, [ ] speed, b brain viewer.
